description.value: Nektar's is a neighbourhood pizza and Greek food restaurant in the Dollarton Shopping Centre on North Vancouver's eastern waterfront edge. The menu spans hand-made pizzas with 20 fresh-cut toppings alongside a full slate of Greek specialties—souvlaki, spanakopita, slow-roasted lamb shoulder, and housemade pasta sauces. Both dine-in and pickup are available, with delivery offered within a 3 km radius.
